Name: Planter Trees
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod lets you grow trees and fruit trees in [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Garden_Pot]garden pots[/url] that are surrounded by other garden pots in a 3x3 grid.

It is intended to be used with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11411]Connected Garden Pots[/url].

For fruit trees to bear fruit in garden pots, you will need to install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11422]Fruit Tree Tweaks[/url].



[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires SDV 1.5.5+

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
